rationale: dual_domain_supervised-claude-agentic: unet_c=16, epochs=32, batch_size=1, lr=0.0005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-4 dual_domain_supervised on re-split Breast-CT (train3600/val200/test200, seed20260703), val=200. SIX-BOX vs the BEST config (iter-2 c16/ep20 hr=0.8372): (1) PRIOR: iter-1 hr=0.8095 (c16/ep10), iter-2 hr=0.8372 (c16/ep20, BEST), iter-3 hr=0.8243 (c32/ep20 — REGRESSED, 3x params no gain). (2) Failure mode: c=32 was over-parameterized (capacity is NOT the lever); revert to the winning c=16. Open question: is c16 still EPOCHS-limited beyond 20? The 10->20 step gave +0.028 hr. (3) ONE KNOB vs the best config: epochs 20 -> 32 (unet_c=16 is iter-2 value, lr/lambda_neg/grad_clip unchanged). (4) HYPOTHESIS: at c=16, raising epochs 20->32 lifts hr above 0.8372 because the 10->20 doubling was still improving and the supervised MSE likely keeps descending; expect hr ~0.84-0.85. If it plateaus, epochs is saturated and iter-5 pivots to lr. (5) BUDGET: iter-2 ep20=440s -> ep32 ~ 700s << 20 min (30-min sbatch wall; breast single shared projector). (6) iter-5 dispatched on landing. Artifacts (recon_raw.npz + model_ckpt.pt) saved via AGENT4CT_SAVE_RECON / AGENT4CT_MODEL_CKPT to this iter dir.
